A value of the log in the form the register gives it

log_value_as_register.Rd

The one place where a value read from details would be brought to the form the API gives for the same field, before anything compares the two: the seal of a version rebuilt from the log, log_executed_row(), and the names the report dates, report_person_since(), both read through log_written_value(), which calls this.

Usage

log_value_as_register(value, field)

Arguments

value

Values as details carries them, NA where none was read.

field

The field they were written into.

Value

value, in the register's form.

Details

Today it changes nothing, decided on 2026-11-12: M1 found no difference on the live register between the values the log carries and those of the register (non-ASCII letters, capitals, spaces at the edges, fields never written), and the forms it did not cover (apostrophes, & < >, quotes, dates written by the form, emptied fields, a project_id with a leading zero) are to be measured on the test instance (M2). A difference found there, systematic and reversible (an HTML entity, the order of a date), is undone here, by field. A wrong undoing cannot pass for a right one: the rebuilt version would no longer give the channel's seal, and the row would read as not verified.
